basic_info.description: Beautiful, house-like, full floor, top level, 3BDR/2BA, ~1900 square foot, sun-drenched condo w deeded garage parking, in-unit laundry rm, and a 99 WalkScore  in the heart of Mission Dolores! Light filled double parlor w bay windows, soaring ceilings, crown moldings, built-in shelving and a decorative fireplace. Open kitchen and dining spaces flow together, w a 2nd decorative fireplace  the perfect entertaining flow! Pro kitchen w granite counters, stainless appliances, and plenty of work and storage space. Huge pantry w laundry area. 3 spacious BDRs w warm wood floors. Double parlor room closes w pocket doors to become a flexible 4th BDR space  a guest room, home office, or family room. Sleek 2nd full, tiled BA. By day the expansive views of the surrounding domes and steeples transport you to Rome, and by night enjoy the twinkling lights on Twin Peaks and the surrounding hillsides. Lovingly lived in by the same family for 20+ years, and long term owners in the 2 other units. Freshly painted throughout. Deeded private garage pkg and copious storage. Serene, shared brick patio. A walker's paradise, located in the heart of Mission Dolores and the iconic Valencia corridor. Steps to world class parks, shops, restaurants and cafes, MUNI and BART. Mins to 101/280. Wow!
